definitions.explanation: An artificial or stocked pond where customers pay to fish, typically for koi, carp, trout, or other freshwater fish. A popular leisure facility for families and casual anglers.

examples.english: I went to a fishing pond with my child.

examples.japanese: {釣|つ}り{堀|ぼり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{気軽|きがる}→気軽：06865_kigaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Even beginners can casually enjoy fishing at a pay-to-fish pond.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{釣|つ}り{堀|ぼり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{釣|つ}った→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}いて→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: At the neighborhood fishing pond, you can grill and eat the fish you catch on the spot.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧ (fishing) + ⟦{堀|ほり}→堀：03725_hori⟧ (pond, moat). The reading of ⟦{堀|ほり}→堀：03725_hori⟧ shifts to ぼり due to rendaku.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釣|つ}り{堀|ぼり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to a fishing pond
- {釣|つ}り{堀|ぼり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{釣|つ}る→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧: to fish at a fishing pond
- ⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧{釣|つ}り{堀|ぼり}: indoor fishing pond
- ⟦{鯉|こい}→鯉：02209_koi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{釣|つ}り{堀|ぼり}: carp fishing pond

CULTURAL NOTE:
A popular casual leisure activity, especially with families and groups. Equipment is rented on-site, and fees are typically based on time or per fish caught. Common targets include ⟦{鯉|こい}→鯉：02209_koi⟧ (carp), ⟦{鮒|ふな}→鮒：26341_funa⟧ (crucian carp), and {鱒|ます} (trout).
